chains.name: Uranium & nuclear fuel cycle
chains.thesis: Reactor restarts, life extensions, new builds and datacenter-driven nuclear PPAs collide with a decade of mine under-investment; the term-contracting cycle reprices the whole fuel chain — miners, converters, enrichers, fuel services — years before spot moves show it.

commodity.spot_source: web-cited (UxC/Numerco via press) or SRUUF/U.UN trust NAV proxy — uranium spot is NOT an FMP commodity

chains.notes: The one chain where the contracting cycle (term vs spot) is the regime tell. UROY is the royalty pure-play (business_model=royalty_streamer, auto-passes cash gates). Restart/greenfield developers (NXE, DNN-class) are lane_b via dated milestones (permits, FID, first drum).

chains.name: Copper & electrification metals
chains.thesis: Grid build-out, datacenters, EVs and reshored manufacturing add structural copper demand into a thin project pipeline — new mines take 10+ years from discovery to first cathode; the cost curve reprices producers long before the deficit closes.
chains.notes: 'Copper' and 'Aluminum' industry strings are (verify) — confirm against /stable/available-industries on the first live run; 'Other Industrial Metals & Mining' is proven in themes_map.py. Diversified miners (TECK-class) need commodity_revenue_share from the chain map, not 1.0.

chains.name: Rare earths & strategic metals
chains.thesis: Export controls turned rare earths, antimony, gallium and tungsten from commodities into strategic chokepoints; Western governments now act as forced buyers (price floors, DoD/DOE awards, stockpiles), repricing every ex-China ounce on policy datelines rather than spot.

commodity.spot_source: web-cited (Shanghai Metals Market NdPr via press) — NdPr is NOT an FMP commodity

chains.notes: The policy chain: most catalysts are government datelines, not price. 'Other Precious Metals & Mining' and 'Specialty Chemicals' are (verify) — Specialty Chemicals is included ONLY to catch processors/separators FMP files there; the chain map must drop actual chemical companies (chain_fit_confidence=low). UUUU carries uranium_fuel_cycle AND this chain (counts toward both caps).

chains.name: Power for AI
chains.thesis: Datacenter load growth outruns grid interconnection; whoever can deliver firm electrons or the equipment to make them — turbines, transformers, switchgear, nuclear-levered IPPs, grid EPC — sells into a queue measured in years.

commodity.spot_source: FMP commodities (Henry Hub front month) — the fuel-cost driver for IPP spark spreads, not a revenue driver

chains.notes: Overlaps disruptor energy_transition (GEV/ETN/CEG-class) — ALLOWED: different books, never blended; the cross-book overlap report must flag shared names. SMR developers (OKLO/SMR-class, pre-revenue) are lane_b via NRC/COL datelines, never lane_a. This chain's torque metric is margin-vs-power-prices, not margin-vs-metal.
